question: Who is pleased by streams, and when would Bhairava be pleased by hand-drinking?
premises: they are pleased indeed — vetala-spirits and rays — by stream
Bhairava would be pleased then, supreme hand-drinking
inference: Stream-pleasing of spirits precedes Bhairava pleased by hand-drinking.
plain_english: They are pleased indeed — vetala-spirits and the rest, rays, by stream; Bhairava would be pleased, hand-drinking, supreme, then.
